def calc(s: str) -> int:
    total1_str = ''.join(str(ord(c)) for c in s)
    total1 = int(total1_str)
    total2_str = total1_str.replace('7', '1')
    total2 = int(total2_str)
    sum1 = sum(int(digit) for digit in total1_str)
    sum2 = sum(int(digit) for digit in total2_str)
    return sum1 - sum2
